description: Fail-loud hardening of makeGetTrackedFiles/makeIsIgnored so a git failure (non-repo cwd / git absent) throws instead of silently yielding zero tracked files.

userStories.title: Throw on git spawn failure in makeGetTrackedFiles/makeIsIgnored
userStories.description: As a maintainer running scripts/validate-agents-md.ts, I need the two git-plumbing helpers to raise a clear error when git fails (non-repo cwd or git absent) so a misconfigured manual run fails loud instead of silently returning zero tracked files and reding the gate with false path-missing findings.
acceptanceCriteria: makeGetTrackedFiles (scripts/validate-agents-md.ts) inspects the spawnSync result status and throws a clear Error (message naming 'not a git repository / git unavailable' or equivalent) when git ls-files exits non-zero, instead of returning an empty tracked-files set. A legitimately-empty git repo (exit 0, empty stdout) still returns an empty list without throwing. [oracle: grep -q 'status' scripts/validate-agents-md.ts]

makeIsIgnored (scripts/validate-agents-md.ts) throws a clear Error when git check-ignore exits 128, while preserving exit 0 -> ignored (true) and exit 1 -> not-ignored (false). [oracle: bun test test/validate-agents-md.test.ts]

New tests in test/validate-agents-md.test.ts assert: makeGetTrackedFiles run against a non-repo cwd throws; makeIsIgnored against a non-repo cwd (exit 128) throws; the existing legit-empty and normal-path behaviours stay green. [oracle: bun test test/validate-agents-md.test.ts]

The error messages match the existing plain `throw new Error(...)` convention used in scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts and scripts/preview-screens.ts (no custom error class). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all), gate #12 self-check unaffected in the normal in-repo path. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file of source + its mirror test. Source: scripts/validate-agents-md.ts makeGetTrackedFiles (lines ~292-297) and makeIsIgnored (lines ~307-312) - both already capture the spawnSync result but discard status; the fix inspects result.status. Tests: test/validate-agents-md.test.ts already has a real-git regression block (~line 489+) that spawns temp repos via spawnSync git init; add the non-repo-cwd throw cases there (a fresh temp dir with no git init makes git ls-files / git check-ignore exit 128). Gotchas: (1) legit-empty repo exits 0 with empty stdout while non-repo exits 128 - use `status !== 0` in makeGetTrackedFiles, do NOT reject empty stdout itself; (2) git check-ignore -q has 3 exit codes: 0=ignored, 1=NOT ignored (normal, must NOT throw), 128=error - only 128 throws; (3) functions are already exported and used by the real-git regression blocks, so no production wiring change needed to test. Out of scope: the identical smell in scripts/ratchet-diff.ts (separate gate, optional follow-up). This is defense-in-depth, not a live bug (only caller check:all always runs in-repo).
